goal: Survive this turn with positive HP and keep enough damage for a near-term finish.
guidance: HP is 8, incoming 30. Neutralize the second follower (16 total attack) to reduce it to 12, making incoming 26; do NOT waste Weak on the buffing Priest. Backflip gives 11 block and draws. You must add more block before ending: Survivor gives another 11, leaving 4 HP; if Cloak appears, its 9 plus Backflip leaves 2 HP and a Shiv, a useful alternative. Spend the third energy on Poisoned Stab into Priest to reach 11 poison. For Survivor discard a surplus attack/Defend, preserve the planned block and Poisoned Stab. Resolve any generated Shiv into Priest. Ending with only Backflip's block is fatal; choose enough block from fresh options, not an early end turn.
